items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I started meeting Bennie Moten and guys like that.

ctx.x: to Detroit. I walked into Detroit, to the Club Harlem which was supposed to be owned by gangsters now...you know how people is. I asked the guy.................. , he asked me where I was from, I said, "Chicago." you know? I called a few names, he said, 'You start...... 'work tonight,' and I stayed in Detroit '33 to '37. And I worked around Detroit and I had an opportunity again to meet a lot of...Now, what I was doing is, I'd only been meeting like territorial bands in the beginning, from the beginning, you…

Then I went to Kansas City. I started meeting Bennie Moten and guys like that. Now, when I get to Chicago, I'm meeting Earl Hines and seeing him every day and,"Hey, Earl, how ya doin'," you know, and that business. But one thing about Earl, Earl never acknowledge that he knew my name, from 1933 until today. Whenever they say, "Sam Price, meet Earl Hines," he meet me all over again.

Well I remember...I was saying that I was beginning to meet a cross section of worldly-known musicians. First we had the territorial bands, well- the local community bands and musicians like Budd Johnson and Keg Johnson and (unintelligible), and then we had the local bands and the territorial bands and then we went on the TOBA, and from the TOBA then we went to Kansas City where that I began to meet guys who really were into music and staying, whom I'd known over the years. And then we went to Chicago where I met…
